text: Raw telemetry is landing safely, but nothing can query it yet. This video catalogs it with Glue and cleans it with a real PySpark job before it reaches anyone's dashboard.
A Glue Crawler catalogs the raw JSON as one real table. A PySpark job then casts every field to its proper type and removes duplicate readings before anything downstream sees them.
The dedup step keys on installation_id and reading_timestamp -- one inverter can't produce two different readings at the same instant, so that pair is obviously enough to identify one reading.
The cleaned output writes to curated storage as Parquet, partitioned by installation_id, then gets cataloged by a second crawler -- the exact table Redshift reads from next.
Raw telemetry is now one clean, trustworthy table. Next: turning it into the daily performance and monthly billing numbers in Redshift.
